label: prf:atom-knot-unique
title: Proof of atom knot unique
html:
Proof. The normal form T_w is unique by the Diamond Lemma (hecke normal form). Two braids that realize the same NF differ only by a sequence of:

  • Reidemeister II moves (the Hecke relation \sigma_i^2 \sim h_{\mathrm{A}} \sigma_i + 1 rewritten in NF).
  • Reidemeister III moves (the Yang–Baxter equation \sigma_i \sigma_{i+1} \sigma_i = \sigma_{i+1} \sigma_i \sigma_{i+1}).
  • Far commutations (\sigma_i \sigma_j = \sigma_j \sigma_i for |i-j| \geq 2).

Each represents a categorical Markov move (Jones–Markov trace). Thus, the closures are isotopic. \square

Scope. Uniqueness holds up to isotopy, not up to strict NF equality. Different w_{q^Z} realizations yield distinct categorical isotopy classes in the abstract braid representation.
